question: Why would egg-nature not apply to every principle individually?
premises: Even without the term mass of reality, egg-nature might seem possible in the principles.
An objection asks why that would not be so.
The verse sets up a restriction on the term's application.
inference: Therefore egg-nature does not automatically apply to each principle taken separately.
uncertainties: The verse is transitional and its full answer comes in the next verses.
plain_english: Even without using the term mass of reality, one might think each principle could be an egg by nature; but the text raises the question of why that is not the case.
